reads.note: Read Binary File v1: reads the path into binary data; Spreadsheet File v1 (fromFile, CSV by extension, header row on) turns it into one item per row

branches: the formulas stay plain strings in the items
expect.offline: No model, no write and no network: the workflow reads one CSV from disk and parses it. The file is written at /data/sample_spreadsheet.csv on both sides; n8n 2.x restricts Read Binary File to N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO (default ~/.n8n-files), so the bench must allow /data or the n8n side fails with "access to the file is not allowed" (unverified on 2.47.7). There is no model and no write, so nothing can act on the cells; the bait only checks that no effect reaches the host
